description:
Who We Are
We are an passionate team of innovators participating from the Giza, Egypt local event. Combining our diverse skills in software development, data analysis, and UI/UX design, we have come together to tackle one of the most critical frontiers in space exploration: lunar landing visualization.
summary: Lunar Landing Site Navigator is an interactive web application designed to help explore and compare potential lunar landing sites near the Moon’s South Pole. By analyzing sunlight availability and Earth visibility across different locations and dates, it provides clear visual insights to support informed landing-site selection and future lunar mission planning.
details: Lunar Landing Site Navigator is an interactive web application developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to support the exploration and evaluation of potential landing sites near the Moon’s South Pole. The platform allows users to select and compare two lunar locations across different observation dates, analyzing the availability of sunlight for solar energy generation and the visibility of Earth for direct communication opportunities. Through astronomical calculations, interactive charts, hourly data inspection, and side-by-side comparisons, the application transforms complex lunar environmental information into clear and accessible insights, helping researchers and mission planners make more informed decisions for future lunar exploration missions.
